description: Forty texts from the committed sweep lists, each at 100, 140 and 260 words per minute. Chosen by rule before any export: the fifth entry of each of the fourteen groups of dectalk-us-sweep-v1; every ninth entry of dectalk-us-sweep-b-v1 from the fifth; every fifteenth entry of dectalk-us-betty-sweep-v1 from the eighth (voice Betty); every sixth entry of dectalk-us-paragraph-sweep-v1 from the third. Each entry's group names its source entry.
